posts.title: 1300 pages of Orwell

posts.title: Let’s Eat! Almean Cuisine
posts.description: I’m working on a new book, Let’s Eat!, hopefully out by Christmas. It’s about Almea, but in an unusual way: it’s a series of essays on the different cuisines of Almea, from an in-world perspective.
